digest.component_or_area: live external LLM provider matrix gate
propositions: Live external integration test fails at line 88 because provider_matrix_live.py compares resolved spec qualifiers literally ('openai:') against REBAR_EXPECTED_LLM_PROVIDER family name ('openai'), but the resolver canonicalizes specs to 'openai-chat:' since commit 8f4c5fdb0d3.

Live LLM test suite silently skips entirely because _live_llm.py's credential map lacks 'openai-chat' entry, causing live_llm_ready() to return False and configured_provider() to fail credential lookup.

Commit 8f4c5fdb0d3 updated the unit-tier matrix gate with family→qualifier mapping (_MODEL_QUALIFIER_BY_PROVIDER) but did not update the live external tier's consumer sites, leaving an unmet obligation.

Fix adds _PROVIDER_FAMILY_BY_QUALIFIER mapping and provider_family() helper to live tier, making configured_provider() return the family name so credential lookup, skip reasons, and guard assertions agree with the declared arm provider.
Provider guard must still reject model classes resolving to a different family (e.g. anthropic class on openai arm) to retain its validation teeth.
